_about: MH4U .mrl v0x20 read through LtShaderPackage.lfx (MFX v52) by mrl.py (the 4U Armor Viewer's): t.albedo is the tAlbedoMap binding (1-based into tex), s the blend-state record (BSSolid/BSBlendAlpha/BSAddAlpha/BSRevSubAlpha). Normal and LUT maps are not drawn; t.extend is the tExtendMap binding, sampled through the glb's TEXCOORD_1 (UV_Extend). f: the transparency feature, AlphaConstant (the map alpha) on every BSBlendAlpha material: 4U MRLs select no features, so the blend state decides.
